verdict.rationale: Greptile's own docs describe deploying the product in your own infrastructure via Docker Compose (up to 100 developers) or Kubernetes (100+, HA). They cover AWS/GCP/Azure, air-gapped environments, self-hosted or bring-your-own LLMs, and logs stored only on customer servers. A 2024 community wish for a local-only option is a feature request, not a hands-on counter-report. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment, and clarity on which plans or licensing terms include self-hosting.
